purpose: Define safe, clearly labelled fixture structures for testing official-property-record evidence flows without fabricating real property facts or claiming live retrieval.
fixture_rules: Every fixture is synthetic unless explicitly marked as source-derived.
Synthetic values must never be presented as real property records.
A fixture cannot establish a real person's ownership, address, title, boundary or legal interest.
Source-derived fixtures must retain their source reference, retrieval date and provenance.
Fixtures are isolated from production legal evidence.
Fixture evidence can test pipeline behaviour but cannot upgrade substantive legal verification status.

source.provenance_note: Artificial data created solely to exercise the evidence pipeline.

facts.statement: Synthetic fixture contains a fictional registered-title field.

test_expectations: The pipeline must accept the fixture as test evidence.
The pipeline must preserve its synthetic provenance.
The fixture must not be treated as an official retrieval.
The fixture must not change production legal verification status.
The public answer must not expose fixture data as a real property fact.
